The apartment

30 m² that work twice

These premises have very high ceilings. We raise the bed onto a steel mezzanine and free up everything underneath. Each apartment sleeps 2+2 guests.

  • Raised bed. The bedroom takes no floor space from the living area.
  • The space below is put to use. Kitchen, wardrobe or workspace under the bed, and storage in the stairs.
  • Modern industrial design. Black steel, wood, exposed brick and large street-facing windows.

From empty premises to an operating apartment

We take on the purchase, the change of use, the works and the licence. You buy a finished asset.

Project 01 · Premises reserved

Portugalete Puente Colgante

A 110 m² street-level corner unit with frontage on two sides. That frontage is what brings natural light into every apartment. Portugalete is home to the Vizcaya Bridge, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and has a direct metro line to Bilbao.

Two ways to run it

The apartment is yours either way. What changes is who does the work and how much you keep.

Higher yield

You manage it

We give you the platform to run it without intermediaries, and you keep the full margin.

  • Calendar and prices synced with the booking sites
  • Self check-in for guests
  • Tried-and-tested cleaning and maintenance contacts
  • No management fee
Hands-off

A professional manages it

A tourist-rental manager takes care of everything and pays you out every month.

  • Listings, pricing and guest support
  • Cleaning, laundry and issues
  • Detailed monthly statement
  • Fee on revenue: 15%

It is not a home. It is a tourist asset built to generate income. As the owner you can block dates for your own use.

If you want to sell later on. We offer it to other investors in our network.
